scriptSource: https://thescriptsavant.com/movies/Viridiana.pdf (English screenplay). Spanish lines translated from that text; timings from ffmpeg silencedetect on Internet Archive Viridiana.mp4 (viridiana_202108).

words.t: Hermana,
words.en: Sister — title before a nun’s name.

words.t: Viridiana.
words.en: Viridiana.

words.t: ¿Madre?
words.en: Mother?

words.t: Acabo de recibir una carta de tu tío.
words.en: I’ve just had a letter from your uncle.
words.pron: ah-KAH-boh deh reh-bee-BEER OO-nah KAHR-tah deh too TEE-oh

words.t: No podrá venir cuando tomes los votos.
words.en: He won’t be able to come when you take your vows.
words.pron: noh poh-DRAH beh-NEER KWAN-doh TOH-mes lohs BOH-tohs

words.t: Está bien, Madre.
words.en: All right, Mother.

words.t: No parece importarte mucho.
words.en: You don’t seem to mind very much.

words.t: Apenas lo conozco. Solo lo vi una vez, hace años.
words.en: I hardly know him. I saw him only once, some years ago.
words.pron: ah-PEH-nahs loh koh-NOHS-koh SOH-loh loh bee …

words.t: Ni siquiera me acuerdo de él.
words.en: I can’t even remember him.
words.pron: nee see-kee-EH-rah meh ah-KWEHR-doh deh ehl

words.t: En cualquier caso, tu tío te pide que vayas a quedarte con él.
words.en: In any case he’s asking you to come and stay with him.

words.t: No quiero salir del convento, Madre.
words.en: I don’t want to leave the convent, Mother.

words.t: Me temo que su salud no es buena. Es tu único familiar y debes despedirte de él antes de tomar los votos.
words.en: I’m afraid his health is not good. He’s your only relative and you ought to say farewell before taking your vows. You will certainly never see him again.

words.t: ¿Pero por qué quiere verme? Nunca se ha preocupado de mí.
words.en: But why does he want to see me? He has never bothered about me.

words.t: Ha pagado tus estudios y tu manutención, y acaba de enviar tu dote.
words.en: He has paid for your studies and your maintenance, and has just sent your dowry.

words.t: ¿Tan poco te importa, Viridiana?
words.en: Does that mean so little to you, Viridiana?

words.t: No tengo ganas de volver a ver el mundo, pero si usted me lo ordena…
words.en: I have no desire to see the world again, but if you order me to…

words.t: El retiro empezará pronto. Puedes marcharte mañana por la mañana.
words.en: The retreat will start soon. You can leave tomorrow morning.

words.t: En tu celda he hecho poner todo lo necesario para el viaje.
words.en: Everything you need for the journey has been put in your cell.

words.t: Ve a prepararte y trata de mostrarle cariño.
words.en: Go get yourself ready, and try to show him some affection.

words.t: Basta por hoy, Rita. ¿Te gusta la cuerda que te regalé?
words.en: That’s enough for today, Rita. Do you like that rope I gave you?

words.t: Salta mejor: tiene asas.
words.en: It’s easier to jump with: it’s got handles.

words.t: Vete ya, vete a jugar.
words.en: Go away now. Go and play.

words.t: Hola.
words.en: Hello.

words.t: Hola.
words.en: Hello.

words.t: Bienvenida, señorita. Soy Ramona, la criada de don Jaime.
words.en: Welcome, miss. I’m Ramona, Don Jaime’s servant.

words.t: ¡Ah! Mucho gusto.
words.en: Ah! Pleased to meet you.

words.t: ¡Viridiana!
words.en: Viridiana!

words.t: Sí, tío. ¿Qué tal está usted?
words.en: Yes, Uncle. How are you?

words.t: Bien… ¿El autocar llegó tarde, verdad? ¿Qué tal el viaje?
words.en: I’m well … The bus was late, wasn’t it? What was the journey like?

words.t: Excelente. ¡Qué lugar tan apacible y encantador, tío!
words.en: Excellent. What a charming, peaceful place, Uncle.

words.t: Creerá que aún está en el convento.
words.en: You’ll think you’re still at the convent.

words.t: El tren llega al atardecer.
words.en: The train arrives at dusk. (Screenplay: carriage; Spanish release often uses tren / this voiceover.)

words.t: El paisaje es árido y silencioso.
words.en: The landscape is arid and silent.

words.t: Viridiana camina hacia la casa de campo.
words.en: Viridiana walks toward the country house.

words.t: Buenas tardes, soy Viridiana.
words.en: Good afternoon, I’m Viridiana.

words.t: Pase, señorita.
words.en: Come in, miss.

words.t: Don Jaime la está esperando en el salón.
words.en: Don Jaime is waiting for her in the drawing room.

words.t: Gracias, Ramona.
words.en: Thank you, Ramona.

words.t: Hace años desde la última vez que te vi.
words.en: It has been years since the last time I saw you.

words.t: Has crecido y te pareces a tu madre.
words.en: You have grown and you look like your mother.

words.t: Prefiero no hablar de eso. Como quieras, sobrina.
words.en: I prefer not to speak of that. As you wish, niece.

words.t: Esta noche descansarás en tu antigua habitación.
words.en: Tonight you will rest in your old room.

words.t: Mañana hablaremos con más calma.
words.en: Tomorrow we will speak with more calm.
